notes.title: 2nd Update!
notes.content:
[p]Hi there!
[/p][p]I've been very busy but I've got some time to add things and improvements to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]In this update a small ending has been added to give closure to the game and to make the window rescalable, as some of you requested.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637381/9690900262d7e9e0a8cffc6ba4cea6d8673f5df1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So far the improvements are:[/p][p][/p][p]- Speed increase button in the postures.[/p][p]- Window mode.[/p][p]- Added the Hobgoblin[/p][p]- New posture for Hobgoblin.[/p][p]- Added Elf.[/p][p]- Kiss" pose for Elf.[/p][p]- New sexual posture for elf.[/p][p]- Rescalable game window.[/p][p]- Small closing cinematic.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637381/b18c197b636cf8bba23701144c6f562f71b2b12a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I still want to add some more things, but it will have to be little by little.[/p][p]Thanks for your understanding and support of the project.[/p][p]
[/p]

tags.feature: - Speed increase button in the postures.

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
[p]Hi! \\(^o^)/[/p][p]I've been looking for some time away from work to improve my game. Not everything I want to put in yet, but little by little![/p][p]As I said, the game will remain simple and will consist of unlocking ingredients and poses, focusing on the quality of the animation. Believe me, frame-by-frame animation is no easy task![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637381/4ae19a7d6b7516b08a68befba8a831360580c703.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]What does this first update bring?[/b][/p][p]- Window mode option (thanks to your feedback).[/p][p]- Option to make the Goblin bar go at x10 speed (you're welcome).[/p][p]- New unlockable character: The Elf.[/p][p]- Stances for the elf.[/p][p]- Special “Kiss” pose for the elf.[/p][p]- New stance for the Orc (It looks great!)[/p][p]- Now the game indicates when you have finished all recipes.[/p][p]
*If you already made extra potions without knowing it, you may have already unlocked the new content!
[/p][p][b]For future updates:[/b][/p][p]- Gallery mode.[/p][p]- Change the hair color of the witch.[/p][p]- Other postures + Ingredient “Witch's Orgasms”.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much for your patience and feedback.[/p][p]I work alone on this part time, I will try to give my best.[/p][p][/p][p]However, I want to emphasize once again, that this will remain a game of simple mechanics, it is not a fun game, it is focused on its practical use.[/p]

tags.feature: - Window mode option (thanks to your feedback).
- Option to make the Goblin bar go at x10 speed (you're welcome).
- New stance for the Orc (It looks great!)
- Now the game indicates when you have finished all recipes.

notes.title: Update coming soon!
notes.content:
[p]Hi there!!! \\(^o^)/  With “Witch Seed: Goblin Slave Alchemy” just released, I am already [b]working on an update[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]The game system will be kept simple[/b], it is one of the premises of this game since the beginning of its development. [b]All the weight is for the production of quality animations frame by frame[/b]. The animations of this game are composed of hundreds of drawings!
[/p][p]- New poses will be added,[/p][p]- The witch will be able to change her hair color.[/p][p]- A new character will be added (an elf)[/p][p]- It will have a cinematic Ending.[/p][p][/p][p]Any kind of proposal or idea that you would like to see in the game, I'm open to requests, I'm listening! steamthumbsup[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much![/p][p]Greetings![/p]

tags.feature: - The witch will be able to change her hair color.
- A new character will be added (an elf)
- It will have a cinematic Ending.
